title: Partition functors and universal exponential relations
summary: We introduce partition functors: algebraic structures indexed by partitions of finite sets and equipped with restriction and transfer maps along refinements. We construct a monad PD on the category of partition functors and on several categories of partition functors with additional multiplicative structure. For a partition ring, exponential elements in its associated completed ring of symmetric functions acquire canonical logarithms after applying PD.
